title: MaxIT: Cloud Cost Clarity, Control & Efficiency Platform | Quadra
description: MaxIT is Quadra's cloud cost intelligence platform delivering real-time FinOps visibility, optimization recommendations, and governance controls to help enterprises eliminate waste and maximize cloud ROI.

blocks.text: MaxIT: Cloud Cost Clarity, Control & Cost-Efficiency Platform

The cloud promised agility, but delivered complexity. Managing multiple platforms, controlling spiraling costs, and ensuring a consistent security posture across your entire estate is a significant challenge for even the most capable IT teams

Max-IT is an AI-infused, intelligent multi-cloud platform that provides a single pane of glass for your entire cloud journey. We architect a framework for continuous optimization, from assessment and migration to governance and security, freeing you to focus on business outcomes.
Deploy a unified framework with drift detection to ensure your multi-cloud environment is always compliant
Leverage AI-driven insights to right-size resources, eliminate waste, and achieve up to 30% in cloud cost savings.
Automate security monitoring and remediation to reduce security incidents by up to 50%.
Utilize our proven tools and frameworks to speed up your cloud adoption journey.
